title: On Expansion of Random Regular Graphs: Improved Lower Bounds for Small Even Degrees
summary: We show that a simple scoring-based tie-breaking can help improve lower bounds for the expansion (aka isoperimetric number) of random regular graphs with small even degrees. Specifically, for degrees 4, 6 and 8, we show that, with high probability, the expansions are at least 0.489, 1.120 and 1.813 respectively.
